images.title: Three things we found
images.purpose: A clean summary of the chapter in three items: equal bisecting diagonals make a rectangle, the families nest, and every quadrilateral's angles add up to 360°.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Three small panels in a row with wide gaps between them, each with one simple figure and one short label under it.
images.exact_structure: Left panel: a rectangle in dark outline with its two diagonals as thick teal (#0072B2) lines crossing at the centre, each of the four half diagonals with one identical short tick mark; label under it: equal diagonals. Middle panel: three nested ovals, the outer one outlined teal (#0072B2) and labelled parallelograms, the middle one outlined amber (#E69F00) and labelled rectangles, the inner one outlined reddish purple (#CC79A7) and labelled squares; each label sits inside its own oval. Right panel: one irregular quadrilateral in dark outline with a small reddish purple arc in each of its four corners, exactly four arcs, and the label 360° in the middle of the shape. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Diagonals decide the family, the families nest, and the angles of any quadrilateral add up to 360°.

image_decisions.why: A three item visual summary helps students hold on to the chapter's main results together.
